plugin.stream_in.chart_aria: Input network bitrate over two minutes, with frozen frames and audio silences.
plugin.stream_in.ingest_hint: The remote source pushes its stream to this address. The IP is the container's, directly reachable on the LAN.
plugin.stream_in.jrn_clear_confirm: Clear the connection journal? Earlier events are permanently lost and can no longer document a past outage.
plugin.stream_in.jrn_count: {n} events in range, {k} most recent below. The export contains all of them.
plugin.stream_in.jrn_hint: Container timestamps, PTP-disciplined: comparable with the rest of the chain. The journal survives a script restart.
plugin.stream_in.jrn_volatile: This container has no state volume: the journal is lost on every deploy and on node reboot. Recreate the container from the palette to make it persistent.
plugin.stream_in.remote_hint: The plugin pulls the stream from this address. Editable here, no redeploy.
plugin.stream_in.stopped: Ingest stopped, test pattern still emitted
type.stream_in.cfg.av_lock.help: ⚠ DISABLED BY DEFAULT. Audio is written to the grid slot of the frame it belongs to, derived from the source pts. Measured on 2026-08-23 on a real SRT link, the lock does WORSE than no lock: A/V offset +275 ms instead of +38, and less stable audio age. Two known defects (origin error of about 270 ms, lock that moves too often) — see TODO.md. Only enable it to work on it, not in production.
type.stream_in.cfg.av_lock.label: A/V lock (source timeline)
type.stream_in.cfg.av_margin_frames.help: Locking the audio onto the video presentation instant removes its arrival margin: any late block becomes silence. The video is presented N frames later — BOTH essences shifted by the same amount — to give it back. DO NOT set it by guesswork: the margin actually available varies from one ffmpeg session to the next (measured on 2026-08-23: +255 ms on one session, ~0 on another, for the same link). It is “audio margin” on the plugin page that decides — it must stay clearly positive. 0 = no hold-back.
type.stream_in.cfg.freeze_timeout_ms.hel: Beyond it, the last frame is repeated and the state becomes “frozen”.
type.stream_in.cfg.genlock.label: Genlock (PTP grid)
type.stream_in.cfg.idle_mode.label: Frame when there is no stream
type.stream_in.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.stream_in.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.stream_in.cfg.mode.help: Listen: the source pushes to the address shown on the plugin page. Call/pull: the plugin fetches the stream.
type.stream_in.cfg.mode.label: Ingest mode
type.stream_in.cfg.mode.opt.srt_caller: SRT — caller (we pull a remote source)
type.stream_in.cfg.slice_lines.help: Band height (lines). Must divide the frame height (36 for 1080p) — otherwise falls back to whole frame.
type.stream_in.cfg.slice_lines.label: Lines per slice
type.stream_in.cfg.slice_mode.help: Video is published band by band on the MXL bus: downstream starts on the first band without waiting for the full frame (sub-frame latency). Interlaced or non-divisible height → falls back to whole frame. Disabled (default) = historical behaviour.
type.stream_in.cfg.slice_mode.label: Slice mode (sub-frame latency)
type.stream_in.cfg.srt_latency_ms.label: SRT latency (ms)
type.stream_in.cfg.srt_passphrase.label: SRT passphrase
type.stream_in.cfg.srt_streamid.label: SRT stream ID
type.stream_in.cfg.tap_udp.help: ffmpeg copies the RECEIVED flow, without transcoding, to this UDP address. The flow arrives over a single-consumer SRT connection: this is the only way to inspect what we actually receive (A/V relation of the pts, announced rate, GOP structure), and a measurement taken after our own chain cannot tell what comes from the source from what we added. Leave EMPTY outside diagnosis — it is extra network traffic.
type.stream_in.cfg.tap_udp.label: Incoming flow tap (diagnostic)
type.stream_in.label: Stream In
